theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_ald_ball_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (U A : Set (Eucl P)) (Φ : Eucl P → Prop), IsOpen U → A ⊆ U → (∀ (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), closedBall y r ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (A ∩ ball y r)), Φ x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict A), Φ x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
